name: Streamystats Integration
description: Jellyfin 12 integration with dashboard setup, per-user visibility, health checks, automatic embed-or-new-tab mode and a one-rule proxy setup.
overview: Embeds Streamystats as a responsive Jellyfin 12 Web view.

versions.changelog:
- The statistics entry is now an icon in the right header tray (next to search/cast, like Jellyfin Enhanced's random button) instead of the user menu.
- No icon on pages without the user menu, such as the video player.
- The client script URL now carries a build id, so CDNs such as Cloudflare no longer serve a stale script after an update.

- Menu entry moved into the Jellyfin user menu (no longer in the top bar or over the video player).
- The stats view closes on every Jellyfin navigation, including playback start.
- Hybrid opening: embedded when Streamystats allows framing and shares the site, otherwise a new tab.
- Proxy setup reduced to one header rule (Nginx/NPM, Cloudflare, Caddy, Traefik); session-reset endpoint removed.

Initial Jellyfin 12 release.

- Guided setup directly in the Jellyfin dashboard.
- Modern and Legacy Web navigation with responsive embedded Streamystats.
- Per-user visibility and fail-closed Streamystats session switching.
- Nginx, Nginx Proxy Manager, Caddy and Traefik guidance.
